name: Wrong validation verdict
about: An invoice validates differently here than in another tool, or a verdict looks wrong
labels: verdict

**What happened**
<!-- e.g. "BR-CO-15 is reported but the totals look correct" -->

**The invoice (required)**
Attach the invoice, or a minimized version that still reproduces the verdict.
Strip anything confidential first — replace names, IBANs and amounts; the
structure is what matters. Even better: paste just the relevant XML fragment.

**What other tools say**
<!-- e.g. "the KoSIT validator accepts it", "ecosio reports the same" -->

Ground rule from CONTRIBUTING.md: our verdicts follow the official EN 16931
Schematron artefacts. If we differ from the official artefacts, it's our bug.
